create_perceptionlm_model: create a PerceptionLMModel instance for multimodal image-text understanding with a vision tower and language model
run_perceptionlm_generation: run PerceptionLMForConditionalGeneration to produce text outputs conditioned on image and video inputs
build_multimodal_projector: build a PerceptionLMMultiModalProjector that projects vision tower features into the language model embedding space
get_image_features: get image features from the vision tower by passing pixel values through the multimodal projector
test_placeholder_mask: test the get_placeholder_mask method to validate image and video token alignment with input embeddings
